title: Sail Riviera San Diego

services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: Revel in the calm waters of San Diego Bay as the sun sets over the Pacific, casting a warm glow across the skyline. This private luxury sunset sail offers an intimate and elegant setting-perfect for proposals, celebrations, or simply an extraordinary evening on the water. Enjoy your favorite cocktails, selected wines, craft beers, and beautifully presented gourmet charcuterie as you sail through one of the most scenic harbors in the world. As the evening unfolds, relax with a glass in hand while the San Diego skyline begins to illuminate against the fading light. services.name: Gray Whale
services.desc: Spend an afternoon aboard SV Riviera and immerse yourself in the wondrous world of sea life as we sail San Diego Bay and the sunlit coasts of Southern California. Our private, 5-6 hour whale-watching excursion isn’t meant to be rushed-it’s meant to be savored. Under sail, the ocean is experienced in near silence, with refined comfort, attentive service, and space to enjoy curated cuisine, conversation, and the subtle anticipation as you search for whales, and dolphins. As an added bonus, throughout your voyage, Captain Michael Merriam-San Diego’s “whale whisperer”-will share fascinating insights about the Pacific’s majestic marine mammals.
